comment: Licenses a dependency may be under without review. An SPDX expression passes when every AND operand passes and at least one OR alternative does. Anything else fails `pnpm check:licenses` until it is reviewed and added here.

reviewed.comment: Copyleft licenses, allowed only for the packages named (a glob ending in * matches a prefix), each reviewed

LGPL-3.0-or-later.why: ZenFS and the two libraries it is built on: bundled unmodified, with their texts in /usr/share/licenses and the steps to use your own copy in /usr/share/licenses/@zenfs/README.md (the @zenfs/* packages also carry the web-application exception in COPYING.md)

GPL-3.0.why: TypeScript definitions of the public package.json schema, a single index.d.ts with no code: a development dependency whose only use is a type (JSONSchemaForNPMPackageJsonFiles) that is erased when the kernel is built, so none of it is bundled, linked or served

MPL-2.0.why: build and documentation tooling, unmodified; MPL-2.0 is file-level and nothing of it is in what ecmaOS ships except the generated docs theme, which REUSE.toml annotates

exceptions.comment: Packages whose metadata says nothing or something unparseable, checked by hand
exceptions.spawndamnit: no SPDX in package.json ('SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'); the LICENSE file is MIT (a development dependency of changesets)
exceptions.canvas-linux-x64-gnu: prebuilt binary of node-canvas, which is MIT; no license field (development dependency)
exceptions.canvas-linux-x64-musl: prebuilt binary of node-canvas, which is MIT; no license field (development dependency)
exceptions.@bytecodealliance/componentize-js: 'Apache 2.0 OR GPLv2': used under Apache-2.0 (the dual license is Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only, with the LLVM exception)
